page.layout: One printed page. Heading at top: "INDEX VERBORUM HEBRAICORUM", set centred in spaced capitals. Below it, one column of index lines: Hebrew headword at the right, then a Latin gloss and page references at the left of the column. A blank line separates the groups. Hebrew catchword and gathering signature at the foot.
page.head: INDEX VERBORUM HEBRAICORUM
page.l: ב cum verbo affectus objectum notat. p.346.
בגר unde בוגר p. 375 & בוגרים p. 297.
page.notes: The catchword גבר stands at the lower left, not the right. The gathering signature reads "Iiii". No page number or running head is printed. The entry "בגר" is a headword with cross-references to "בוגר" and "בוגרים" as printed. The separator in "אף·כי" is a printed dot. "איר" is printed as shown and I am reasonably but not fully certain of its vowel-less form. Hebrew is transcribed from the scan without vowel points, as printed.
